workAmount.title: Work amount report
workAmount.subtitle: The income of the visits registered in the period — cash and credit, without cancelled services — grouped the way you need.
workAmount.emptyHint: Widen the period or pick another branch.
workAmount.todayOnly: Your role may report on today only.
workAmount.earliestDay: Your role may report from {day} onwards.
workAmount.footnote: Gross = list prices; cash income = patient shares after discount; credit income = payer shares; net = cash + credit. Cancelled services are excluded.
error.REP-001: Your role may not report on a period that far back.
error.REP-002: The period is not valid: it must start before it ends and cover at most a year.
error.REP-003: You may report on your own branches only.
error.TENANT-004: Select a branch before opening the report.
